sections.label: 01  Privacy policy
paragraphs: This website is run by Eleven Sound LLC, 2255 Barry Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90064.
We only collect what you choose to send us, like your name and email when you write to us. We use it to reply, and that’s it.
We don’t sell or share your personal information. We may use privacy-friendly analytics to see which pages get visited, without identifying you.
Under California law you can ask what we hold about you, or ask us to delete it. Write to [privacy contact email].

sections.label: 02  Cookies
paragraphs: This site only uses the cookies it needs to work, like remembering whether the sound is on or off. No advertising cookies, no tracking across other sites.
